description: Score a chart from 1 (very bearish) to 100 (very bullish) from its price and volume, with the chart patterns found (break of structure, double bottom/top, head and shoulders, triangles, flags, breakouts on volume, engulfing candles, trend structure), each marked bullish or bearish by its measured success rate and returned with drawing points. Pass contract (+ chain when the address alone is ambiguous) to identify a token exactly — two coins that share a ticker are never confused; its DEX pool candles are read — OR symbol (Binance USDT pairs, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL) OR candles (list of {time, open, high, low, close, volume} or CSV text, 60-5000 rows, any asset). timeframe 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w. 50 = the base rate (the share of all study candles that rose); coverage.note says where the study does not cover the coin or timeframe. From EventTrader's Chart Analyzer (cymetica.com/chart-analyzer). Pattern success rates come from a measured study on real daily candles with a held-out test (see chart_analyzer_study). Read-only, no key. Not financial advice.

candles.description: your own candles instead of a symbol (time, open, high, low, close, volume)

chain.description: chain of the contract: ethereum, solana, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, sui … (needed only when the address alone is ambiguous)

closed_only.description: score closed candles only (reproducible until the next close)

contract.description: token contract address (0x… on EVM chains, base58 on Solana); identifies the coin exactly

symbol.description: crypto ticker, e.g. BTC (Binance USDT pair)
